notes.title: Steam Presence and PlayTime Issue Resolved
notes.content: Steam is now correctly displaying your presence when playing Look and Find Curiosity, and is now correctly registering your time played.

notes.title: Russian language support
notes.content:
We have now added Russian language support to Look and Find - Curiosity.
We currently also support:
Chinese (simplified)
Chinese (traditional)
English
French
German
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Spanish
